desc:
This move is traditionally joseki without the <A:P15>/<B:P16> exchange. But with that exchange in place, the situation becomes advantageous for White because <A:P15> creates potential for White at very low cost, and <B:P16> has become inefficient.

See [Michael Redmond, *AlphaGo vs. The World: Game 47, Tan Xiao 7p (W) vs. AlphaGo Master (B)*](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Lf0We2j5h8M&t=195s).
